title: Vibrant Flaky Moroccan Mozzarella Bissara
description: A pescatarian-friendly, crowd-pleasing Moroccan dish featuring roasted, flaky mozzarella bissara, topped with char-grilled ingredients.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the sweet potatoes in a single layer.
Roast the sweet potatoes for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly caramelized.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mozzarella balls and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the mozzarella balls to a plate and season with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
In the same skillet, add the chopped cilantro and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 30 seconds.

To assemble the bissara, place a scoop of roasted sweet potatoes in the bottom of a Korean brass bowl, followed by a few mozzarella balls, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a drizzle of the lemon-cilantro sauce.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of mozzarella balls on top.
